propositions: Three near-identical walkers discover replacement links by iterating deps/duplicates then calling find_inbound_relationships for supersedes; they differ only in liveness check and return type, creating maintenance risk

Bug frolicky-dependable-peccary arose because verdict() consulted only find_replacement while duplicate-close-link requirements lived in comments elsewhere, and DISPOSITION_CLASSES equality was held only by test assertion

The shared walk core (duplicates scan plus supersedes inbound scan with optional liveness check) must be extracted to one function replacement_of(), preserving class/type filtering at each wrapper since the three walkers differ there

Guard construction must enforce that find_inbound_relationships() combined with 'supersedes' appears only in close_disposition.py except with reasoned # replacement-walk-ok escape marker, caught by construct-uniqueness test
_NON_COMPLETION_BUG_CLASSES must become a structural alias of close_disposition.DISPOSITION_CLASSES so the two cannot drift apart, verified by identity assertion not equality
Monkeypatch seams _has_live_replacement_link and _recorded_replacement_target must keep their exact names and signatures as one-line wrappers to preserve patched test behavior in 738a test suite
